title: ChartGPU: A Beautiful WebGPU charting library, let your browser render millions of points smoothly

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Chart GPU just threw your entire data set straight at the GPU and said, "Deal with it." While every other charting library is choking on a few thousand data points, this thing's handling tens of thousands without breaking a sweat. Line charts, candlesticks, scatter plots, all running buttery smooth because it's using web GPU instead of making your poor CPU do all the work. Three lines of code and you're done. Built-in zoom, tool tips, crosshairs.
